attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This is a substantial, cross-module rework of GraphQL predicate/alias building (renamed/moved public extension namespace, changed IPredicateQuery/IIndexAliasProvider contracts, new partial-alias resolution logic in PredicateQuery and ContentItemsFieldType) that touches core query-filtering behavior used by every content type's GraphQL API, so a subtle bug in alias resolution or SQL column mapping could silently corrupt or break existing GraphQL queries across all tenants despite the added tests."}
